description: Installation and maintenance manual of a fictional 4-axis motion controller, 41 A4 pages: Simplified Chinese body text with English parameter names and Japanese terms in brackets, set in WenQuanYi Zen Hei (Chinese), IPAGothic (Japanese runs, ja-JP) and Liberation Sans (Latin); long trilingual tables (117-row parameter list, 39-row alarm table with English and Japanese messages, 55-row EN/ZH/JA glossary) whose header rows repeat on every page; footer "第 N 页". Eight scattered edits: the version on the cover (V2.3 to V2.4); a new safety warning paragraph in section 1.3, which pushes every later page down by about four lines (the note deleted in 5.1 pulls the pages after it back by two lines); a note deleted in section 5.1; the factory default of P2-07 Acceleration Time (220 to 180); the English message of alarm AL.150; the cooling fan replacement interval in section 7.3; one Japanese glossary term; and a new V2.4 row in the revision history on the last page. Table splits, repeated header rows and footer page numbers change only as consequences. Producer: LibreOffice Writer 24.2 (python-docx .docx -> soffice --convert-to pdf), WenQuanYi Zen Hei / IPAGothic / Liberation Sans.

truth.note: Cover page document version. "V2.3" also stays in the revision table on the last page.
